prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Post-adoption/certificate sign-in reordering, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners worked; post-waiting sign-in hurt, while other sign-in reorders and sync hints showed no clear effect.
Path selection clarity headlines, spotlight layouts, and certain visual redesigns worked; checklist layouts and story scroll narrative redesigns hurt, while copy simplifications, value refreshes, and time banners showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints worked; 3D trackers, completion timers, sound notifications, and background activity displays showed no clear effect.
Companion previews paired with quality guides or split upload layouts worked; compact grids, photo fallback flows, guidelines banners, and mascot stamp redesigns hurt, while pre-adoption review flows, ownership guarantees, and layout customization showed no clear effect.
Interactive spawn placement flows and system tray location tips worked; direct controls guides and first interaction tips hurt, while mascot greetings, docking hints, retrieval callouts, and welcome stage redesigns showed no clear effect.
Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive wins (e.g., interactive spawn placement flow, visual redesigns) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (e.g., mascot stamp redesign, direct controls guide, story scroll redesign).

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Placement Verification Screen: Add a dedicated verification screen right before onboarding completion to confirm pet desktop rendering and position. (why: Support reported multiple complaints of pets missing from the desktop, and the finish step has a high mean duration of 5815s.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Multi-Step Photo Quality Inspection Flow: Introduce a split-layout photo inspection flow with real-time feedback and photo tips during upload. (why: 3 support emails specifically reported custom pet creation issues or incorrect pet appearances.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Delivery Progress Stage Indicator: Add detailed progress tracking and time estimates on the waiting screen while desktop assets render. (why: Home waiting median duration is 201s (mean 2336s); progress visibility reassures users while assets download.)
3: [sign_in, notification] Account Sync & Pet Recovery Notification Banner: Display a explicit account recovery hint explaining that signing in safeguards companion data across sessions. (why: 8 support emails (the single largest theme) reported lost or reset pets upon re-authenticating.)
4: [finish, layout] Home Welcome Split Screen Showcase: Change the home intro screen layout to split view featuring pet welcome graphics and completion confirmation. (why: Finish step drop-off is 24.6% with extremely high mean time (5815s); clean structure helps users complete setup.)
5: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Companion Guarantee Hint: Add a reassurance hint on the adoption certificate screen promising multi-device account preservation. (why: Adoption has the biggest drop-off (31.1% abandon) and account pet loss was reported 8 times in support.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Seamless Account Restore Headline Refresh: Update sign-in headline and body text to clearly state pet restoration and cross-device syncing. (why: Clear sign-in messaging addresses user confusion around missing pets after re-authenticating.)

scores.note: Adding a new screen at finish step adds severe friction, matching historical -14.4% failure.
Targeting high drop-off adoption with multi-step flows historically hurts completion (-5.7%).
Progress stage indicators and waiting room info reliably improve retention during long downloads.
Addresses top support issue (8 mails) with sync banners that worked in earlier tests.
Finish step drop-off is high; split layout structural refresh provides moderate positive lift.
Strong evidence and high impact step, but adoption hints and banners historically perform poorly (-5.0%).
Account recovery copy updates have strong historic win rate (+4.2%) addressing key support theme.
